# cm_custom_flow (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cm_custom_flow" "opa_validation" {
  name = "OPA validation"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The unique ID of the custom flow.
- `name` (String) The name of the custom flow.
